title: Unified onboarding flow for embedding + reranker models with automated profile publishing
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Create a single, auditable onboarding flow that accepts embedding and reranker model artifacts, performs compatibility checks, runs standard microbenchmarks, generates a versioned performance profile, and publishes that profile to the model catalog. The flow must support version pinning (semantic version + build hash), validate inference semantics (embedding dimensions, normalization behavior, reranker score ranges), and generate reproducible performance metrics (latency P50/P95, throughput, memory footprint) in CI and on a small dedicated GPU staging pool.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding API endpoint accepts a model bundle (tar.gz) and metadata and returns a validation report or a clear error
System produces a versioned performance profile artifact with stable schema stored in model-catalog (S3 path)
Profiles include latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, GPU memory, embedding dimension and euclidean/cosine normalization flags, reranker AUC/ndcg on provided eval sets
New profile is surfaced in the Console under model details and is selectable for version pinning in routes
Automated tests in CI exercise the onboarding flow with a sample embedding and reranker model and assert profile fields and schema
Rollback: if profile publish fails, model remains unpublished and onboarding logs a remediation ticket with failure reason
tech_notes: We will reuse existing kernel selection hooks from runtime-1.20. Add a new validation step to run a short 1k-step KV-cache warmup and 100-req microbenchmark for latency sampling. For rerankers, integrate the small eval harness that computes ndcg@10 against a reference dataset stored in S3. Profiles must be signed with the build pipeline key before publishing.
implementation_steps: Add onboarding endpoint and controller that accepts bundle + metadata
Create validation workers for embeddings and rerankers with pluggable checks
Wire microbenchmark runner to staging GPU pool and capture metrics into perf-collector
Serialize profile JSON to canonical schema and upload to model-catalog S3 prefix
Update Console model details page to display profile and expose 'pin this profile' action
Add CI job that runs onboarding for sample models and asserts profile schema
Document the flow and update ops runbook for profile publish failures
testing_plan: Unit tests for validation logic, integration test that runs onboarding end-to-end on staging pool (sample embed + rerank models), and manual QA in Console verifying profile display and version pinning. Add load test to ensure onboarding worker queue scales for 50 concurrent onboarding jobs.
monitoring_and_rollout: Emit metrics: onboarding.job.started, onboarding.job.succeeded, onboarding.job.failed, profile.publish.latency. Alert if failure rate > 5% over 1 hour. Gradual rollout: enable for internal models, then beta customers, then all self-serve. Monitor customer feedback and Console errors for 72 hours post rollout.
rollout_plan: Week 1: internal-only. Week 2: opt-in beta customers (feature flag). Week 3: GA. If any critical failures, rollback feature flag and open incident playbook.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Microbenchmarks may produce noisy latency numbers across instance types. Mitigation: normalize by hardware profile and include hardware tag in profile. Risk: Data leakage from eval sets — ensure eval datasets are access-controlled and scrubbed.
